result.reason: The operative language provides a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months’ fees and $1 million, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and all required preferred carve-outs, so it comfortably reaches at least the fallback position. It also excludes identified Company payment obligations from damages. However, it goes beyond the stated position by categorically excluding lost profits and revenues, even where they may be direct damages, and by exempting Excluded Claims from both the cap and the damages exclusion rather than merely making them uncapped. The payment clarification is also narrower than the playbook’s general treatment of all Customer payment obligations because it covers only Section 3 payments and any Termination Payment. Otherwise, the addition is mutual, preserves unrelated terms, and is professionally drafted.
